notes.title: Accounts and Database Changes
notes.content:
Hi everyone, Judah here. This update is full of a lot of internal changes which unfortunately took a while to finish. But it's out now! Check out the changes below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40381686/a493fff91428d3ed100f3ef8994253d204242ac0.jpg
SpatialOS Update
The SpatialOS integration has been updated to version 15.3.0! This was the bulk of the update and took the most time. We hope this fixes the big memory leak that's been causing major server slowdowns.

Account Migration and Database Changes
We outgrew PlayFab! Our data needs are more than what we can do comfortably in PlayFab, so we are switching back to our own accounts and database system. PlayFab is not bad, but all data in PlayFab is associated with a player account in someway. This makes world data trickier to set up when we want to save dynamic NPCs, add managed town / regions, or anything else that is not tied directly to a player. The way the data was stored, quests were items, skills were items, and NPCs were going to be player accounts. In the end, we decided it would be better to use our own database so we can store all the data we want.

You will see an initial increased load time on the Character Select Screen, but it will be faster once your characters transfer over. Please report any missing items or new bugs.

Basitin Stomp
Basitins can learn Stomp from the Basitin Guard in the Island Town Hall. Stomp is a crowd control attack that hits enemies in an area that only Basitins can learn. Basitins are more tanky than the other races so we are giving them skills that can draw aggro to keep other party members safe.

[previewyoutube=L2tHKlRAGnY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Other Changes
Optimizations. We are hoping this fixes the big memory leak that's been causing major server slowdowns.Fix for the chocolate bunny drop for the Easter Egg Event. The Easter Egg Event will be extended for another week.Inner Mana Color option for character creator.Pinned Quests on task list.Test Building Land Plot.Bug fixes and other tinkerings.Bugs
Skill usage progression is broken for the new Basitin Quest. This will be fixed ASAP.

notes.title: Update and Christmas Event 2021
notes.content:
It's update time and the start of the of the Christmas event!

Christmas Event

It's here! Santa Claus is coming to town, and his sleigh keeps dropping presents! Collect 10 presents from the sleigh and receive a red hat from Santa. Santa only visits at night, so keep an eye out for his sleigh. You can also hear the jingling bells when the sleigh is close.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40381686/95c02f603a1129229bad90cf502255ca12a9a5ca.jpg

Start the quest by the inn.

Pat Emote

You can now /pet or /pat.

[previewyoutube=uyLxE3qtruw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


Character Movement Changes

Characters should move around smoother than before! We adjusted how the server calculates the player's position so there should be less jitters, even with high ping. You may notice other players have some position delay but we're still working on that to get movement as accurate as possible.

Other Changes

New Blacksmith Npc!
Some tavern npcs.
Experimental localization for Spanish!
Basic text support for Cyrillic.
New weapon crafting recipe!
Fix a bug with the level cap.
Some disconnect error codes.
Bug fixes

notes.title: TwoKinds Online - Mid November Bug Patches
notes.content:
A small update today, mainly focusing on bug fixes. Our server lag issues are not completely cleared up yet, so these next few updates will be for performance improvements over new features.

Controls Setting Page

A new controls tab is being worked on in settings. Keys cannot be rebound just yet, but should be after a few more updates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40381686/f4094c31bdc1327e4994f9a8db25f9aebcd67363.png

Changes


Level up character and skills now say who leveled up.
Blackberries no longer say they are coal.
Some internal errors fixed.
Chat no longer allows multiple new lines. Please no more Bee Movie scripts.
You can no longer craft with a full inventory.
Slight adjustment to the boob physics while running.
Link to the comic page!
Link to the founder shop!
There is a boat at the dock.

notes.title: TwoKinds Online - More Quests
notes.content:
It's update time! This update contains changes to quests, bug fixes, and a new creature to the islands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40381686/595918cb55546898f3a9471b7ff7f9856a51647b.jpg

Quests

Quests now save progression between sessions! Leaving the game and returning will no longer reset quests. I know this was a long requested feature and now it is here!

Templar

The Templar in the town hall has some magic skills to teach you, so make sure to go say hello. Humans and Keidran will be able to learn Light and Firebolt from the Templar trainers. Basitins will have to wait to learn new skills since they cannot use magic. The Basitin Trainer is still not ready yet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40381686/90d8bc26403489e806ce9e8e76584a837ed6e69f.png

Resetting Quests

If you want to reset to redo quests again, head over to the town hall and talk with the Secretary. Flora can also reset quests for the moment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40381686/e4368fd1d0e41769f2dcb4d34ee28de4cea50b21.png

Combat Exp and Kill Count

Combat kills are changed from last hit to who contributed. Everyone who has contributed to killing an enemy will now get kill credit for quests and exp.
Bear

There is a new creature, the Bear! They like foraging for berries and are aggressive so watch out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40381686/52237a746601406e1157a80e6f55a2347d9e4592.png

Halloween Event

The Halloween event will be ending around 11/14, so make sure to get the event items while you still can!

Server Performance

It took a lot of hunting, but the terrible server performance bug has finally been squashed. Thank you all for hanging in there with us, so now we can focus on more improvements and features! Nothing is finalized yet, but we might give out a commemorative shirt in game. "I survived 2021 lagginess" or something like that.

Other Changes


Unity updates for 2020 LTS.
Characters already logged in will be immediately disconnected.
More bug fixes.
Bear and berries.
Yarn Spinner narrative updates.
Default name tag does not show in character create anymore.

notes.title: TwoKinds Online - New Combat
notes.content:
Hi everyone, big changes to combat! Other changes include NPC factions, animation system overhaul, and more! Due to time constraints, this is part one of the combat series updates.

Changes


 New Animation System
Combat

   Melee attacks
   Stat updates 
   Ranged bows still WIP

Left-handed characters
Sprint
Factions
Dances
Guild Chat with Vivox
Improved town buildings
Playtest changes and Steam achievements
End of Discord game updates
Physiology Skill


Combat

Melee combat has been completely redone! Tons of adjustments have been made so the experience should be a lot smoother. Due to the time constraints, this will be part one of the combat updates, soon to be followed by Bows/Ranged weapons, blocking, and improved AI combat tactics.

[previewyoutube=DBgkcHcL7WI;full][/previewyoutube]

NPCs will now show relative power levels in their name tags. Normally the information is hidden but can be viewed by holding ALT. Name tags for NPCs will also show basic health information that will increase in detail with the skill Physiology.

Foxes and rabbits are now easier to hunt and no longer will attack on sight. Beware of butterflies though, they are violent.

Sprint

Movement has been changed and there is now a sprint button! Sprinting uses stamina and can be used to break from combat or faster world traversal.

Factions

Npcs are now split into more factions than just violent and nonviolent. Foxes will no longer attack immediately. Town people now react and attack back if they are hit. They will no longer just stand idly and embrace death but will fight back.
https://cookiedragon.sfo2.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/blog/v0_54_0/TwokindsOnline20210722T23_28_32_136544807_00.png

Dances

New dances! Up to 4 available dances now.

[previewyoutube=1cE12uygVME;full][/previewyoutube]

Guild Chat

Guild chat is now available using Vivox. We are liking Vivox so far and will use it for party chat and friend whispers in the future.

Playtest Changes

We are switching to the Steam playtest feature for testing access instead of grabbing a Steam Key from the website. Make sure to request access on the Steam Store page and don't forget to wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/690100/TwoKinds_Online/

https://cookiedragon.sfo2.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/blog/v0_54_0/PlaytestAccess.PNG

We are also adding some Steam achievements unique to the playtest game, so make sure to get them if you are an achievement hunter. We don't plan on revoking access to the unreleased game if you used a Steam key but we recommend switching to the playtest on Steam.

End of Discord Game Updates

We are ending support of playing the game through Discord. With the end of the Discord Store years ago and other things, we are focusing on Steam as our main platform to play. The Discord version will not be getting any more updates so make sure to switch to the Steam playtest.

Up Next

We are really excited for what's coming next. We are very busy working on bows, new content, new enemies to fight, and of course always more! Thank you for being on this adventure with us.

Original blog post on twokinds.online
